author: James-F2
what_it_is: Illusion of Gaia save made while confirming a Mode 7 bug on MiSTer (Jan 2020): 'Exit school and got up to castle (talk to guard before staircase)'.
note: Untouched SRAM is filled FF 00 FF 00 ..., the pattern MiSTer builds of early 2020 left (SNES_MiSTer issue #189: 'the core only fills every other byte of save ram'), which points to MiSTer having written it.
